photos.c: Back Page: Meet some of the 'Belles'. Left to right - Wendy Richardson, Jane Pritchard, Anna Matthews, Tina Couzens, Joan Samuels, Pat Mead and Win Shepherd.

[illegible]hilst our mens' team was not at its best at Luton on October 30th, our girls made up for it. Highly placed in the 5km walk were (left to right) Anna Matthews 3rd/31:00, Wendy Dunsford 6th/35:22 and Diane Cook 5th/33:39; with Jane Pritchard (right) first home in the under 15 2.5km group and Barbara Dunsford (not in picture) 5th.
Jane Pritchard (S) won the under 15 2.5km walk at Luton on October 30th in 15:08.
Early Belles - 1976 at Battersea Park. Left to right are: Wendy Richardson, Jane Pritchard, Anna Matthews, Tina Couzens, Joan Samuels, Pat Mead and Win Shepherd.
